svg.title: Haze sponsor technology relationship graph
svg.desc: Current Haze architecture connecting LangGraph workflows, NVIDIA Nemotron model routes, optional Meterless Nightshift inference and background jobs, Zetaris evidence retrieval, Haze authoritative SQLite state, and separately packaged Meterless reference engines with H-MEM disabled.

g.text: How sponsor technology fits into Haze
Current code connections, service boundaries, and reference-only integrations
Connections show implementation; live readiness is separate.
One local backend + one SQLite owner
v3 objectives · permissions · budgets · leases · operation receipts
Embedded StateGraph execution · SQLite checkpoints · wait / resume
Evidence collection · PM2.5 analysis · damage appraisal
Reduction planning / programmes · independent numerical checks
SQLite records · immutable artifacts · source provenance
Relationships · review outcomes · holds · cross-task lineage
Source-linked answers · reviewed work products · explicit evidence gaps
Bounded REST queries + exact source rows
Pinned at task admission; exact model + cap
Role reasoning via NVIDIA HTTPS API
Readiness checks and explicit grants apply
Vendored upstream engine and original control-plane example.
Active Haze domain state uses the transactional SQLite store above.
Pinned source + conformance checks are retained.
Historical dashboard memory is archival; live task memory is unattached.
Architecture evidence: app/composition.ts · app/tasks/runtime.ts · app/adapters/model-routes.ts · app/tasks/world-store.ts
Nightshift automatic successors remain production-gated. World Model acceptance requires a configured supported policy.
